entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How may I assist you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. It's a VeloBand Pulse. It's not working right.
Okay, I can help you with a return. Can you please provide your order number?
Thank you. Let me pull that up. Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse here. What seems to be the problem?
It keeps disconnecting from my phone. And the heart rate monitor is way off. I’ve only had it a couple of weeks. This thing is junk.
I understand your frustration. Our standard return policy allows for returns up to 90 days from purchase. To initiate the return, I'll just need to confirm your shipping address.
Ninety days? Great! Finally, something’s going my way. Just get this thing out of my hair. The address is the same one on the order.

Perfect. I've confirmed the address. I've processed the return and emailed you a prepaid shipping label. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at your nearest shipping location. You'll receive a full refund once we receive the VeloBand Pulse.
Alright, fine. Whatever. Just get it done. Thanks... I guess.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Actually, yeah. I was looking at getting a smart watch instead. Do you guys have any that pair well with the VeloBand app? I’m not sure if I want to try another one of your products again.

We have a wide variety of smart watches available that are compatible with the VeloBand app. I can direct you to our product page or provide some specific recommendations if you tell me what features you're looking for. Also, if you don’t feel comfortable with that, I can always get my manager to help. He may be a little better at the technical side of things.
No, you know what? Never mind. This has been a complete waste of time. I'm done.
Sir, I am sorry you feel that way. Is there anything I can do to change your mind or help you further?
Sir? Sir, are you still there?
